documents.title: Internal note: how and when OFAC screening is performed
documents.text: OFAC screening (internal procedure). Every case subject - the customer id, each card id, and any counter-party name that appears in the evidence - is screened against the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) list using the Treasury sdn.csv and alt.csv exports (exact match after normalisation, then fuzzy token-set matching at a 90 percent threshold). The screening result and the list version are recorded as external evidence (ref: ofac_screen) on the case, and every SAR introduction states whether any subject is OFAC/SDN-related, as FinCEN's narrative guidance asks. The dataset's customers are anonymised identifiers, so a match is not expected; a 'no match' statement is still required.
